messages.author: 188806804221876c
messages.subject: matrix with a single row
parts:
I am using matlabStan.

In my stan code I declare the following matrix

data {

matrix[q,Nsamples] x;

}

My  code when from matlab I send a row vector (q=1) rather than a matrix. 

I get the following error:
std::exception::what: mismatch in number dimensions declared and found in context; processing stage=data initialization; variable name=x; dims declared=(1,100); dims found=(100)

I wonder how to get a code which works  both for q=1 and q>1.

thanks

messages.author: a236d3d356ca53fd
messages.subject: Re: matrix with a single row
parts:
Matlab doesn't have separate data type for matrix and vector, so when you are forming the data structure in Matlab it guesses the type based on the size, but it can't guess what you mean here, and so you need to explicitly specify that you want a matrix. 

Here's an example were xt is specified to be 2-dimensional matrix, and yt is specified to be 1-dimensional vector
datcv=struct('p',p,'N',N-1,'Nt',1,'x',x(ii,:),'y',y(ii),'xt',{{x(cvi,:) 2}},'yt',{{y(cvi) 1}});

It's a bit kludgy and it's not yet documented (Brian?)

Aki
